Report: Attack in West Bank Village Leaves Journalist and Another Injured

A reported attack by Israeli settlers in the West Bank village of Abu Falah left at least two people injured, including a journalist, and damaged olive trees.

By LokkeeVerse · 1 min read

According to reporting from Times Now, an incident involving militant Israeli settlers occurred in the West Bank village of Abu Falah during the annual olive harvest.

The report states that Palestinians were targeted in what was described as a coordinated attack. As a result, at least two individuals sustained injuries, including a journalist, while olive trees in the area were burned. Additional circumstances and official findings regarding the incident remain subject to further verification.
